archetypes.name: dyn-boundary-modes
archetypes.rationale: Verify boundary mode semantics across all migrated callers
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on correctness of boundary mode assignments in migrated callers: whether finding-heading, oos-heading, item-heading, or level-three-heading was correctly chosen for each consumer. Verify that OOS-only paths use oos-heading, mixed paths use level-three-heading, and no existing block-segmentation contract was changed. Check edge cases with empty input, preamble, and mixed FINDING/OOS blocks. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
